body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> LG Electronics(www.lge.co.kr) presented its transparent keypad-enabled handset 'LG-GD900 Crystal' during KES 2009. When opened, GD900's sliding, translucent keypad illuminates a cool glow that reflects the phone's sleek and polished silver body. Supporting touch wheel and multi-touch functions, it also lives up to the highest level of technical features expected in a premium handset, including its dedicated Bluetooth headset. Adopting a 3-inch WVGA full touchscreen, it also supports 'Gesture Shortcut' function, an 8M camera, a 32GB built-in memory, Wi-Fi connectivity and more.
